offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells orthopedic medical devices, including surgical implants and recovery and rehabilitation products. Customers are hospitals, surgeons, clinics and patients, reached through direct sales forces, distributors and retail channels.

primary_products.value: orthopedic reconstructive implants; surgical robotics and navigation; bracing and supports; rehabilitation and cold therapy devices; soft tissue repair products

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, orthopedic surgeons, clinics, physical therapists, distributors; B2C: patients buying bracing and recovery products

end_markets.value: orthopedics; healthcare; sports medicine; physical rehabilitation

revenue_model.value: product sales: implants, instruments, braces and rehabilitation devices sold to providers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes orthopedic implants and devices from purchased materials, sold to hospitals, surgeons and distributors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Prevention and recovery products plus reconstructive and surgical implant lines, all orthopedic

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales representatives selling to hospitals and surgeons; distributors / dealers: independent orthopedic distributors and medical dealers; third-party retail: retail and e-commerce outlets for bracing products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance and EU MDR approval, reimbursement and healthcare compliance rules
